lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Zn2 (Mg6Zn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows that Mg and Zn centers each adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg, Mg–Zn, and Zn–Mg neighbor distances ranging from about 3.00 to 3.40 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg and Zn coordination polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
